tech.title: TECHNOLOGIES
tech.desc: AnewStyle glowing stone panels combine three interesting technologies. The connection of a thin layer of natural stone with side illumination of a light guide plate with uniform full-area light diffusion. This method of illumination allows for easy replacement of the light source if necessary.

home.stoneConstructionAlt: Exploded construction of an illuminated stone panel
home.mineralConstructionAlt: Exploded construction of an illuminated mineral panel
home.stoneTechnology: A lightweight, flexible and transparent natural stone veneer. The stone layer is 2–3 mm thick.
home.mineralTechnology: A transparent, cast design panel with a stone texture and high mineral content. It is rigid and transmits light exceptionally well. It is 6 mm thick.
home.stoneSurfaceShort: Natural pattern with a textured surface
home.mineralSurfaceShort: Smooth surface in gloss or matte finish
home.featuresIntro: The lighting principle is shared. The differences are in the front material, overall thickness, weight and surface.
home.stoneTotalThickness: 16 mm for SLIM; 34 mm for BASIC and DELUXE
home.mineralTotalThickness: 20 mm for SLIM; 38 mm for BASIC and DELUXE
home.stoneSurface: Natural textured surface treated with nano impregnation. Moisture-resistant, but not designed for direct contact with running water.
home.mineralSurface: Smooth gloss or matte surface with no impregnation needed. Moisture-resistant.
home.sharedFeatures: Lighting, control options, mounting and service vary between the SLIM, BASIC and DELUXE versions. Find the exact differences in the shared equipment comparison below.
home.commonMountingDesc: Both panel types can be installed vertically or horizontally. BASIC and DELUXE hang like a picture; SLIM uses a mounting kit.
home.commonRepairDesc: The construction allows servicing and replacing LED components when needed later on.
home.commonCustomDesc: Along with sizes L to XXXL, custom dimensions can also be requested.
home.commonLightingDesc: Dimming, control and rear-lighting options depend on the chosen version.
